title: A Family of Lanthanide Hydroxo Carboxylates with 1D Polymeric Topology and Ln4 Butterfly Core Exhibits Switchable Supramolecular Arrangement

material_class.structural_family: 1D ribbon polymer of tetranuclear butterfly {Ln4(mu3-OH)2} hydroxo-pivalate cores; alpha (triclinic) and beta (monoclinic) packing polymorphs

synthesis.procedure: Method 1 (aqueous, shared for Ln = La-Er): an equimolar Hpiv/Na(piv) buffer was prepared by dissolving NaOH and pivalic acid in distilled water; an aqueous Ln(NO3)3·xH2O solution was added. The clear solution was heated to 70 °C and evaporated until the volume was reduced to 20 mL. The microcrystalline product precipitated during evaporation, was filtered, washed with distilled water, and stored in a desiccator. As-obtained material is the triclinic alpha phase, sometimes with a minor beta-phase admixture. Nonaqueous methods 2a (acetonitrile/[meaH]piv) and 2b (DMF/[meaH]piv) are described without numerical amounts and are reported to give pure Ln4 only for narrower Ln ranges.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Microcrystalline solid precipitated on evaporation to 20 mL, was filtered, washed with distilled water, and stored in a desiccator. Single crystals of the lighter Ln4 members were obtained only from method-1 solutions left to evaporate in air for two weeks.

properties.summary: Alpha-Dy4 shows weak antiferromagnetic coupling, a low-temperature chiT kink from competing ferro- and antiferromagnetic intracluster interactions, slow relaxation without zero-field chi'' maxima (QTM), and field-induced single-chain magnetism under 3000 Oe. Ab initio anisotropy axes lie nearly in the Dy4 plane.

material_class.structural_family: dehydrated 2D-ordered mesostructure retaining the tetranuclear butterfly core but losing translational order along the ribbon

synthesis.procedure: As-obtained Ln4 (Pr-Er, either polymorph) was heated under vacuum at 130 °C for 90 min. Completeness of dehydration was monitored by weighing. The anhydrous intermediate Ln4(OH)2(piv)10 was cooled, suspended in distilled water in a closed vial for 24 h to rehydrate, then filtered and kept in a desiccator. Main text: water is also lost on heating to 200 °C in air or argon, or to 130 °C under vacuum.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After dehydration the sample is the anhydrous mesostructure. Rehydration for 24 h restores Ln4; for Dy the rehydrated phase is the beta polymorph.

properties.summary: Dehydrated Dy4' retains slow relaxation but its chiT decreases faster than hydrated Dy4, with a more negative Weiss constant and no low-temperature kink. The change is attributed to shorter intercluster distances and reorientation of anisotropy axes. Zero-field ac data show no chi'' maximum between 2 and 10 K.

material_class.structural_family: discrete trinuclear pivalate-nitrate complex; La1 is nine-coordinate and La2 is ten-coordinate

synthesis.procedure: Isolated as a minor byproduct while adjusting aqueous method 1. Several single crystals were obtained and the structure was determined. No separate stoichiometric procedure or yield is given in the main text or in the SI experimental preparation of Ln4.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Several single crystals were isolated. SI describes the molecular structure and two lattice water molecules per complex.
